_comment: LEVEL 4 (component): scheduler wrapper — register cron/interval jobs from one config dict.
name: comp-scheduler
description: Scheduler: APScheduler wrapper, register cron/interval jobs from one config. Import: from {{ utils_dir }}.scheduler import Scheduler
notes: Usage: sched = Scheduler(); sched.register('report', daily_report, cron={'hour': 6}); sched.start() (blocking). Requires: pip install apscheduler (add to requirements.txt). Jobs are logged and failures are caught so one bad job never kills the loop.
